campaign: GRAPHICS_3D unit 1 — nav buoy + lane beacon

liveChaseFinding.place_nav_buoy: 1% frame width at D=144, 3% at D=58; reads as a charcoal needle with a cyan slit, orange postage stamp, and four fins
liveChaseFinding.place_lane_beacon: 5% at D=144, 11% at D=58; reads as a post + arm + cube stack
liveChaseFinding.hitchPlay: 10% frame width; mixed materials, wells, manufactured hull

referenceReason: Role is existing IALA-style navigation hardware already in the live slot. Chase stills of the live GLB are the defect crop. No generated redesign sheet.

place_lane_beacon.silhouetteToKeep: L-gantry: mast + outbound arm, not a 30m spire replacement

billedZones.fiction: Zero-g inertial cage: thick cruciform yoke and ring so the planform is a cross, not a stick.
billedZones.material: cast stabilizer alloy, unmapped charcoal metal, roughness ~0.48
billedZones.chaseMustShow: dark cross at the keel on play_chase

billedZones.fiction: Replaceable coated pressure can. Orange IALA daymark is a physical band, not a decal stamp.
billedZones.material: neutral coated shell + finite orange service marking
billedZones.chaseMustShow: narrow coated spine and an orange daymark band at D=58

billedZones.fiction: Four-azimuth nav lantern. Chase looks down, so the roof well is the player-visible optic.
billedZones.material: near-black dielectric optic, opaque, no transmission; recessed in the roof
billedZones.chaseMustShow: dark well with a rim on play_chase_close, not a cyan sticker

billedZones.fiction: Load-spreading plinth and a thick painted mast. Existing L identity, manufactured section.
billedZones.material: warm grey coated hull over alloy collars
billedZones.chaseMustShow: square base and a thick post, not a ladder of holes in a wafer

billedZones.fiction: Outbound rangefinder / lane lantern. Box truss arm, hooded well on the pod roof because chase looks down.
billedZones.material: alloy truss, coated pod, dark optic well, amber only on contact hardware
billedZones.chaseMustShow: arm with thickness and a dark hole on the far pod
